claims.claim: Apollo and Goldman Sachs priced about $44 billion in senior and subordinated notes to finance GPUs and related equipment for SpaceX.
claims.episode_span: priced about $44 billion in senior and subordinated notes to buy GPUs and related equipment for SpaceX
claims.source_title: Apollo and Goldman Sachs Price $44 Billion SpaceX GPU Financing for NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI Infrastructure
claims.supporting_quote: Apollo Global Management (NYSE: APO) and Goldman Sachs (NYSE: GS) have announced the successful pricing of approximately $44 billion in senior and subordinated notes to finance the purchase of graphics processing units (GPUs) and related equipment for SpaceX (Nasdaq: SPCX).

claims.claim: The SpaceX GPU financing was oversubscribed and increased in size, and the companies call it the largest GPU financing executed to date.
claims.episode_span: after the book was oversubscribed and the financing was increased
claims.source_title: Apollo and Goldman Sachs Price $44 Billion SpaceX GPU Financing for NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI Infrastructure
claims.supporting_quote: The transaction, which was oversubscribed and increased in size following strong investor demand, represents the largest GPU financing executed to date, according to the companies.

claims.claim: Lease schedules for the SpaceX GPU financing are expected to start when equipment is delivered in the first half of 2027.
claims.episode_span: Lease schedules start when the equipment is delivered in the first half of 2027.
claims.source_title: Apollo and Goldman Sachs Price $44 Billion SpaceX GPU Financing for NVIDIA Vera Rubin AI Infrastructure
claims.supporting_quote: Lease schedules associated with the financing are expected to commence when the GPUs and related equipment are delivered during the first half of 2027.

claims.claim: A BASENOR report says the SpaceX GPU debt is held by Saturn Funding Trust and that lenders required the GPUs to stay on Earth in SpaceX-controlled U.S. data centers.
claims.episode_span: the hardware sits in Saturn Funding Trust, which leases it back to SpaceX
claims.source_title: SpaceX Lands Record $44B Financing to Buy Nvidia Vera Rubin AI Chips
claims.supporting_quote: The financing is structured through a special purpose vehicle called Saturn Funding Trust , which leases the hardware back to SpaceX.
